en: Black‑and‑white printed postcard showing an industrial sawmill complex beside a waterfront or log yard. Several long wooden buildings stand on slightly raised ground with elevated ramps or conveyors leading down toward a muddy shoreline strewn with logs and timber. Three small human figures are visible in the yard. The image is bordered by a white margin containing printed Finnish text and a photographer credit, plus a handwritten number at the lower left.
